narracao: Seu cão destrói tudo e te deixa exausto? O OvoCroc ativa o instinto de caça, cansa ele em 15 minutos e traz paz pra sua casa. Chega de sofá rasgado e latido! Dê um fim à destruição hoje.

cenas.prompt: Cinematic, photorealistic. A close-up shot on a happy, medium-sized dog (e.g., Golden Retriever) intensely focused on a green OvoCroc toy. The toy subtly rolls and wobbles across the pristine beige sofa with each gentle nudge from the dog's nose, showcasing its self-moving action. Soft, warm natural light highlights the dog's playful concentration.

Cinematic, photorealistic. Starting from the dog happily playing with the OvoCroc on the intact beige sofa, the camera slowly glides upwards to reveal a relaxed woman (30s-40s) in the background, observing her dog with a serene, relieved smile, holding a cup of tea. The overall scene emphasizes a peaceful, undamaged home environment, bathed in soft, inviting natural light.
